'''Crash Pit Six''' was a crash pit at the [[Sarnus Refinery]] industrial complex on the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]]. The pit was one of an array of crash pits into which [[astrolith]]s&mdash;crushed [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fragments&mdash;were [[The Drop (process)|dropped]] from the planetary [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], then transported to grinding mills for processing. In [[45 ABY]], the [[biot]] [[Dena Yus]], an agent of the [[Columi/Legends|Columni]] industrialists [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]], sabotaged the [[Refinery/Legends|refinery's]] protective [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]]; subsequent unprotected astrolith drops onto [[Crash Pit Three|Crash Pits Three]] and Six resulted in the Sarnus Refinery's [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|destruction]].<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Crash Pit Six appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
